timing: Exact frame positions are generated from accepted natural-speed narration in media/timeline.json.

shots.purpose: A successful answer leaves an unresolved ability question.
shots.visible_action: Magnet lands; a laptop and spreadsheet are drawn; the success marker moves into the result cell.
shots.camera: Pull back from the magnet; blue connector leads to the title.
shots.sound: Magnet impact, black and blue felt strokes.

shots.visible_action: Large AI: LEARN line, smaller OR JUST FINISH? line, orange underline.
shots.camera: Settle on the title, then follow the blue line right.

shots.purpose: Separate four outcomes that are often conflated.
shots.visible_action: Four boxes: help, alone, later, new problem. Add measurement labels and a shared brace.
shots.camera: Hold for sequence; travel diagonally to the two scoreboards.
shots.sound: Distinct pen lifts and drawing sounds.

shots.purpose: Show the assisted-performance reversal and the guarded-tutor qualification.
shots.visible_action: A red-hatched Turkish flag locates the study. The same line-drawn learner works at a blue laptop during practice, then writes on orange paper in the unaided exam. Keep +48%, -17%, relative control and the guarded-tutor qualification clear.
shots.camera: Reframe downward as each part develops.
shots.sound: Music briefly drops at the unaided-exam reversal.

shots.purpose: Limit the first result and supply a successful instructional design.
shots.visible_action: Open physics book, equation and bulb; a learner faces the explanation with a notebook and a hand at their chin. Keep the immediate-result label, tutor ingredients and retention caveat.
shots.camera: Progressively widen and reframe to preserve the complete explanation.

shots.purpose: Make recognition and production visibly different.
shots.visible_action: An answer bubble points to a thinking learner holding a notebook; the physical eraser removes the answer while the learner and their choice remain.
shots.camera: Small downward reframe keeps heading and erased answer together.
shots.sound: Felt eraser follows the continuous wipe path.

shots.purpose: Prevent the advice from becoming unguided struggle.
shots.visible_action: Three pages move from worked example to hint to independent attempt.
shots.camera: Travel down to the example sequence.
shots.sound: Pen queues preserve distinct physical markers.

shots.purpose: Turn the argument into a usable, qualified routine.
shots.visible_action: A seated learner makes a first attempt; a useful hint appears, is hidden, and leads to a recall question followed by feedback and correction.
shots.camera: Travel left; hold while the routine builds.
shots.sound: Felt marks and low music continue under speech.

shots.purpose: Keep transfer and delayed retention separate.
shots.visible_action: Two problem pages A and B; a clock; separate transfer and retention labels.
shots.camera: Travel left to the final test region.
shots.sound: Sparse bell phrase supports the later-return idea.

shots.purpose: Return to what the learner can do independently.
shots.visible_action: Return to the title; add principle and circle the final question; reveal the physical framed board and tray.
shots.camera: Return upward, hold, then pull back to the whole board.
shots.sound: Cap impact, three-second music fade; no black flash.
